entries.name: Lore
entries.effect: A Fragment of the TOME's Agenda.

entries.name: Warning
entries.effect: The TOME shows the shapes of the next two Leaves; choose their order.

entries.name: Bargain
entries.effect: Gain 2 Lumen dice now; the next chapter's Depth rises by 2.

entries.name: Temptation
entries.effect: You may open a Page for free; Hunger rises by 1.

entries.name: Judgment
entries.effect: Answer your Bond Question again; if the answer changed, remove 2 Stress.

entries.name: Silence
entries.effect: The TOME says nothing. Gain 1 Stress.
